pins.title: How to Sell on Vinted UK: Beginner's Guide (2026)
pins.description: New to selling on Vinted? This UK beginner's guide walks you through creating a listing, taking photos that show the real item, pricing against similar items, posting your parcel and getting paid to your Vinted Balance. Perfect for decluttering clothes, shoes and household items.
pins.alt: Pin titled How to Sell on Vinted UK, a beginner's guide covering listings, photos, pricing, postage and payment.

pins.headline: Your First Vinted Listing Checklist
items: Check shipping steps after a sale
pins.title: Vinted First Listing Checklist (8 Steps) | Sell on Vinted UK
pins.description: Before you list your first item on Vinted, run through this 8-step checklist: clean it, photograph flaws honestly, write a searchable title, add measurements, compare prices, pick the right parcel size and keep everything inside the app. Save it for your next declutter.
pins.alt: Checklist pin with eight steps for a first Vinted listing, from cleaning the item to keeping everything inside Vinted.

pins.headline: 6 Vinted Mistakes Beginners Make
items: Hiding flaws instead of showing them
Poor photos and a vague title
Throwing away proof of posting too early
pins.title: 6 Vinted Selling Mistakes Beginners Make (and How to Avoid Them)
pins.description: Selling on Vinted for the first time? Avoid these common beginner mistakes: hiding flaws, guessing parcel sizes, following payment links outside the app, vague titles, binning your proof of posting and constantly re-uploading listings. Read the full UK guide.
pins.alt: Pin listing six common Vinted beginner mistakes, each marked with a cross.

pins.headline: What to Photograph for Vinted
pins.title: Vinted Photo Tips: What to Photograph So Buyers Trust You
pins.description: Good Vinted photos show the real item in good light: the front, the back, the label, and any wear or damage. Honest photos mean fewer questions and fewer problems after the sale. More beginner tips in the full UK guide.
pins.alt: Pin listing what to photograph for a Vinted listing: front, back, label, wear or damage, in good light.

pins.headline: Asking price ≠ selling price
pins.sub: Search Vinted for similar items in similar condition before you set your price. Only leave room for offers if you're happy to negotiate.
pins.title: How to Price Items on Vinted UK (Without Guessing)
pins.description: Not sure what to charge on Vinted? Remember that an asking price doesn't show what something actually sells for. Compare similar items in similar condition, then decide whether to leave room for offers. Beginner-friendly UK guide.
pins.alt: Pin with the statement 'Asking price is not selling price' and advice to compare similar Vinted items before pricing.

pins.headline: 5 Steps After a Vinted Sale
items: Check the label, carrier and deadline
Pack it to match the parcel size
pins.title: Sold Something on Vinted? 5 Steps to Post It Correctly
pins.description: Made your first Vinted sale? Open the sold-item conversation, check the carrier, label and deadline, pack it to match the parcel size, use the instructed drop-off so tracking updates, and keep your proof of posting until the order completes.
pins.alt: Pin with five numbered steps to follow after a Vinted item sells.

pins.angle: How You Get Paid on Vinted
pins.headline: How You Get Paid on Vinted
items: Money moves to your Vinted Balance
Withdraw to your bank or spend on Vinted
pins.title: How Do You Get Paid on Vinted UK? Payments Explained
pins.description: Wondering when Vinted pays you? Payment is held while the order completes, then moves to your Vinted Balance. You can withdraw it to your bank or spend it on Vinted. Identity checks can sometimes be required. Full beginner guide inside.
pins.alt: Flow diagram pin showing how Vinted payments move from held to Vinted Balance to your bank.

pins.headline: Keep it inside Vinted
pins.sub: Keep messages and payment in the app. Be wary of anyone asking you to use an outside payment link or share sensitive details.
pins.title: Vinted Seller Safety: The One Rule That Avoids Most Scams
pins.description: The simplest Vinted safety rule: keep communication and payment inside Vinted. Be wary of messages with external payment links or requests for sensitive information. More seller safety tips in our UK guide.
pins.alt: Pin with the safety rule 'Keep it inside Vinted' and a warning about outside payment links.

pins.angle: Do You Pay Tax on Vinted Sales?
pins.headline: Do You Pay Tax on Vinted Sales?
pins.sub: Selling your own unwanted things vs buying or making goods to sell for profit
pins.title: Do You Pay Tax on Vinted Sales in the UK?
pins.description: Selling your own unwanted possessions doesn't automatically make you a trader. HMRC says buying or making goods to sell for profit is likely to be trading, and platform reporting doesn't by itself mean tax is due. General information only, not tax advice.
pins.alt: Pin asking 'Do you pay tax on Vinted sales?' comparing selling unwanted items with trading for profit.

pins.angle: Vinted Item Not Selling? Check These
pins.headline: Vinted Item Not Selling? Check These
pins.title: Vinted Item Not Selling? 6 Things to Check Before You Re-List
pins.description: Vinted listing getting no interest? Before you delete and re-upload, check the basics: realistic price, searchable title, accurate condition, useful photos and quick replies. Then compare with similar listings and improve. Beginner's guide for UK sellers.
pins.alt: Checklist pin of six things to check when a Vinted item isn't selling.
